rungs.title: Repository Readiness
rungs.acceptance_boundary: A clean checkout is inspected through the packaged workflow command, the clean-worktree policy passes, the workflow writes a tau.repository_readiness_report.v1 useful result, and the run receipt plus artifact digests are independently read back.
proof_required: workflow receipt with mocked=false and live=true

rungs.title: Tau Operator Reference
rungs.acceptance_boundary: Several dependent local stages build and validate an operator reference for one required Tau workflow without provider or network reliance.
proof_required: run receipt showing dependent stages completed

rungs.title: Repository Evidence Map
rungs.acceptance_boundary: A setup stage releases independent documentation, test, and package evidence branches concurrently, then a join publishes a validated repository evidence map.
proof_required: concurrent branch evidence in events/checkpoint state

rungs.title: Approved Release Bundle
rungs.acceptance_boundary: Sequential preparation and concurrent release evidence feed a reviewer/revision path, then an exact human approval boundary guards one rollback-protected side effect.
proof_required: approval-gate BLOCKED receipt without human approval
approval-bound publish receipt with rollback protection

rungs.title: Durable Repository Qualification
rungs.acceptance_boundary: Multiple sequential and concurrent phases survive interruption, resume accepted work without duplicate effects, rerun only repaired affected work, and stop at a final human release boundary.

proves: The five canonical packaged Tau workflow rungs are named in immutable-goal order.
Each rung declares a topology class and acceptance boundary.
does_not_prove: All five workflows execute end-to-end from clean checkout.
